verdict.rationale: The CreateTransaction API records sales, purchases, transfers and returns, so developers can backfill transactions programmatically. AvaTax also says it applies tax logic across ecommerce, marketplace, POS and ERP systems, and the Managed Returns API covers filing. Nothing in the pack documents bulk or historical import, or prebuilt connectors that sync transactions from other processors or storefronts into filings. Missing for 10: bulk/backfill import tooling, documented connector syncs from third-party processors and storefronts, explicit evidence that imported multi-channel transactions flow into returns, independent corroboration.
